policy.planned: Approved or proposed goal only; no runtime assertion
policy.in_progress: Implementation or review actively underway; no runtime assertion
policy.source_ready: Source/config authored or static checked; not client-certified
policy.server_smoked: Relevant components or pack have passed server load; behavior unverified
policy.player_partial: Owner saw some behavior; acceptance criteria not exhausted
policy.player_pass: Owner reported this bounded feature behavior working; not final release certification
policy.deferred: Explicitly not targeted in current test window

release_rule: Only player_pass with recorded evidence may render a checked box; never equate server-smoked or source-ready with in-world complete
